FOUNDATIONAL_SETUP.description: Initialize durable PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md context files
Analyze existing repository to bootstrap initial design context

END_TO_END_CREATION.description: Full end-to-end design and build lifecycle with iterative refinement
Architect interface layout, information hierarchy, and content model
Produce component code adhering to active DESIGN.md tokens

AUDIT_AND_CRITIQUE.description: UX and visual hierarchy critique across clarity, pacing, and typography
Technical audit of accessibility, responsive layout, and contrast
Add robust boundary states: empty, loading, error, and overflow handling

POLISH_AND_REFINEMENT.description: Final high-precision visual pass to refine spacing, borders, and rhythm
Remove unnecessary decorative clutter, cards-inside-cards, and visual noise
Enhance affordance clarity, label readability, and state indicators

EXPRESSIVE_TUNING.description: Increase contrast, scale differentials, and visual assertiveness
Reduce visual assertiveness, soften contrasts, and increase whitespace
Refine or diversify color palette while maintaining contrast
Tune typographic scale, measure, leading, and pairing
Adjust spatial distribution, grid alignment, and flow structure
Add purposeful, subtle motion transitions respecting reduce-motion
Introduce tasteful micro-interactions and textural details
Maximal expressive exploration for frontier UI experiments

ADAPTATION_AND_EXTRACTION.description: Adjust layout for mobile viewports, touch targets, and responsive shifts
Streamline DOM depth, reduce repaint areas, and optimize layout shifts
Extract reusable design tokens and components into DESIGN.md
